tool_args.rationale: The observations show a saturating response to u_now modulated by s_grad. Fit competing positive two-channel saturation forms numerically and select the best training fit for fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The open-branch observations show a strong dependence on s_grad.
The pilot response saturates rather than increasing linearly with u_now.
The two available relevant probes have already been acquired; the expanded data support fitting and fresh confirmation.
